title: One finite-stage pushout square for a tensor model
statement: Let $I$ be a directed preorder and $F:I\to\mathrm{CommRing}$ a diagram with colimit cocone $(C,\iota)$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Fix $i\in I$, finitely presented $F(i)$-algebras $A,B$ [def-weil-pbc-finitely-presented-algebra] and an $F(i)$-algebra map $f:A\to B$. Let $P,Q$ be commutative rings, $Q$ a $P$-algebra, with $P$ finitely presented over $\mathbf Z$ and $Q$ finitely presented over $P$. Put $X=C\otimes_{F(i)}A$, $Y=C\otimes_{F(i)}B$. Given a $P$-algebra structure on $X$ and a ring isomorphism $e:X\otimes_PQ\simeq Y$ whose restriction to $X$ equals $1\otimes f$, there are $k\ge i$ and $q_k:Q\to B_k=F(k)\otimes_{F(i)}B$ such that the map $B_k\to Y$ composed with $q_k$ is $e$ composed with the right inclusion. Moreover $A_k=F(k)\otimes_{F(i)}A$ admits a $P$-algebra structure for which its induced $P$-map to $B_k$ equals the one through $Q$, and the square $P\to A_k$, $P\to Q$, $A_k\xrightarrow{1\otimes f}B_k$, $Q\xrightarrow{q_k}B_k$ is a pushout (its canonical map $A_k\otimes_PQ\to B_k$ is an isomorphism). All scalar extensions use $F(i)\to F(k)$ and $F(i)\to C$ from the diagram and cocone. There is no assertion about later stages.

proof.text:
On the cofinal tail above i, the tensors with A and B have colimits X and Y.
   Tensor products commute with filtered colimits, by representatives and eventual
   equality. Factor P to X through one stage using finite presentation over Z.

The map Q to Y induced by e is P-linear, by he. Factor it through a B stage
   using finite presentation of Q over P. The tensor universal property produces
   a comparison from the model algebra to the prescribed algebra there.

B is finitely presented over A: finite presentation over the common base and
   finite type of A imply this. Both sides of the comparison are therefore
   finitely presented over the A stage. Descend the inverse of e and both inverse
   identities by Tag 05N9, then take a common upper bound.

At the common later stage k the comparison and its descended inverse are inverse ring maps. Transport the canonical tensor pushout along that equivalence. Its restrictions to A_k and Q are the prescribed map f_k and the descended Q-map. Naturality of the factorization gives its equality after passage to Y. This concludes only one finite-stage square, with no assertion about a family on a tail.

theorem exists_tensor_model_algebra_stage
    {I : Type v} [Preorder I] [IsDirectedOrder I]
    (F : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{v}) (c : Cocone F) (hc : IsColimit c)
    {i : I} {A B : Type w} [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    [Algebra (F.obj i : Type v) A] [Algebra (F.obj i : Type v) B]
    [Algebra.FinitePresentation (F.obj i : Type v) A]
    [Algebra.FinitePresentation (F.obj i : Type v) B] (f : A →ₐ[F.obj i] B)
    (P Q : Type x) [CommRing P] [CommRing Q] [Algebra P Q]
    [Algebra.FinitePresentation ℤ P] [Algebra.FinitePresentation P Q]
    (aP : letI : Algebra (F.obj i : Type v) (c.pt : Type v) := (c.ι.app i).hom.toAlgebra
      Algebra P ((c.pt : Type v) ⊗[F.obj i] A))
    (e : letI : Algebra (F.obj i : Type v) (c.pt : Type v) := (c.ι.app i).hom.toAlgebra
      letI := aP
      ((c.pt : Type v) ⊗[F.obj i] A) ⊗[P] Q ≃+* (c.pt : Type v) ⊗[F.obj i] B)
    (he : letI : Algebra (F.obj i : Type v) (c.pt : Type v) := (c.ι.app i).hom.toAlgebra
      letI := aP
      e.toRingHom.comp Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom =
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (Algebra.ofId (c.pt : Type v) (c.pt : Type v))
          f).toRingHom) :
    ∃ (k : I) (hik : i ≤ k),
      letI := (F.map (homOfLE hik)).hom.toAlgebra
      ∃ qk : Q →+* (F.obj k : Type v) ⊗[F.obj i] B,
        (letI : Algebra (F.obj i : Type v) (c.pt : Type v) :=
          (c.ι.app i).hom.toAlgebra
         let t : F.obj k →ₐ[F.obj i] c.pt :=
           { (c.ι.app k).hom with
             commutes' := fun s ↦ ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (c.w (homOfLE hik)) s }
         (Algebra.TensorProduct.map t (AlgHom.id (F.obj i) B)).toRingHom.comp qk =
           e.toRingHom.comp Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom) ∧
        (let D := (F.obj k : Type v) ⊗[F.obj i] A
         let E := (F.obj k : Type v) ⊗[F.obj i] B
         let d : D →+* E :=
           (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id (F.obj k) (F.obj k)) f).toRingHom
         letI : Algebra D E := d.toAlgebra
         letI : Algebra Q E := qk.toAlgebra
         ∃ aPk : Algebra P D,
           letI := aPk
           letI : Algebra P E := (d.comp (algebraMap P D)).toAlgebra
           letI : IsScalarTower P D E := .of_algebraMap_eq fun _ ↦ rfl
           ∃ hPQ : IsScalarTower P Q E,
             letI := hPQ
             Algebra.IsPushout P D Q E)
